title: WaterColor 10 WaterColor Blvd E #301
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Short walk/bike ride to the beach- Located in Park District with views of Cerulean Park - Washer/Dryer- High-speed wireless internet- TVs in all bedrooms- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAIL: WaterColor #10 Unit 301 is a striking 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo located between Scenic 30A and Western Lake in the Park District—named one of the most desirable spots in WaterColor. Guests will love the outdoor balcony, nearby beach access, multiple community pools, and the newly renovated kitchen. This single-story condo sleeps 6.Step off the elevator and onto the glossy hardwood floors of this quiet third-floor unit. A bright and airy atmosphere welcomes guests as they enter the attractive dining room with a chic modern light fixture and seating for 6. The adjoining living room is filled with natural light thanks to the nearly floor-to-ceiling windows and 2 sets of French doors that lead to a generous deck with sweeping park views. An adjacent screened-in balcony provides cozy alfresco dining and additional space. Inside there's an inviting sectional couch surrounded by comfortable armchairs, while freshly painted white walls and tiny accents of vibrant colors add understated elegance. Around the corner is the recently renovated kitchen with new white countertops and wall tile, featuring stainless-steel appliances and wood cabinetry with matching refrigerator doors. Down the hallway are the guest bedrooms—1 primary with a jacuzzi tub, 1 guest room, and 1 bunk room with twin-over-twin bunks. There's also a washer and dryer for added convenience.WaterColor #10 Unit 301 is the perfect Gulf getaway with close access to the beach and other resort-style amenities, like the 2 adult bikes provided with the property. Walk or bike to explore various dining options and local boutiques throughout the WaterColor community. Book now! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Bonus Bunk Room: Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar-white sand beaches- 4 swimming pools - Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World-famous WaterColor Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
